d: Madar is a leading Saudi digital logistics platform, owned by Elm, transforming transportation management across industries. It connects shippers, carriers, and logistics partners through a unified ecosystem that delivers visibility, efficiency, and automation. Madar enables seamless shipment execution, financial integration, and real-time tracking, redefining the future of logistics in the Kingdom and beyond.

Madar is seeking an experienced Finance Manager to lead our financial operations. You will own financial planning, budgeting, reporting, and analysis, and provide insights that guide strategic decision-making. You will also continuously refine financial procedures to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards, and partner with other departments to align resources with business goals. This role is central to the financial health of Madar and to supporting its next phase of growth.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
Fully certified CPA or CMA (completed certification; candidates with only coursework, training, or in-progress status will not be considered)

3–5 years of experience as a Finance Manager or in a comparable finance leadership role, with a proven track record of delivering financial performance; 10+ years of experience in finance management or accounting is strongly preferred
Proven experience in the Saudi market and in the logistics, transportation, or supply chain sector (experience in a digital logistics platform or comparable company is a strong advantage)
Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting
Solid understanding of financial regulations and accounting principles relevant to the logistics sector
Strong knowledge of ZATCA regulations and compliance requirements
Hands-on experience with VAT, excise tax, corporate income tax, and zakat filings in Saudi Arabia
Proficiency with ERP systems and financial software for accounting and reporting
Proven ability to manage and direct finance teams effectively
Ability to work with cross-functional teams across all organizational levels
Business fluency in both Arabic and English
Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia
Based in Riyadh or able to work on-site in Riyadh
Previous experience at a logistics or transportation technology company
Experience working with Saudi regulators and external auditors

d: We are looking for an experienced, results-driven, and commercially focused International Sales Manager to lead global sales activities, expand international markets, and drive sustainable revenue growth.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing international sales strategies, identifying new business opportunities, building relationships with overseas clients and distributors, and managing the complete international sales cycle.
This role requires strong business development capabilities, international market knowledge, negotiation skills, and the ability to build long-term partnerships across diverse markets.
Develop and execute international sales strategies to achieve global revenue and business growth targets.
Identify, evaluate, and penetrate new international markets and business opportunities.
Build and maintain strong relationships with international clients, distributors, agents, and business partners.
Generate new business leads through market research, networking, industry events, and strategic outreach.
Manage the complete international sales cycle, from lead generation and negotiations to contract closure and order execution.
Develop international sales forecasts, business plans, and market expansion strategies.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify global market trends and growth opportunities.
Negotiate pricing, commercial terms, contracts, and agreements with international customers.
Monitor international sales performance, revenue targets, profit margins, and customer acquisition.
Coordinate with internal departments, including marketing, finance, logistics, production, and supply chain, to ensure timely order fulfillment.
Develop and manage relationships with international distributors, resellers, and strategic partners.
Monitor customer requirements and ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention.
Represent the organization in international trade exhibitions, business meetings, and industry events.
Prepare international sales reports, market assessments, and management presentations.
Monitor international trade regulations, export documentation requirements, and market-specific compliance standards.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Marketing, Sales Management, or a related field.
5–8 years of relevant experience in International Sales, Export Sales, Global Business Development, or a similar role.
Proven track record of achieving international sales targets and developing overseas markets.
Strong understanding of international trade, export procedures, and global business practices.
Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills.
Experience managing international clients, distributors, and business partnerships.
Strong knowledge of sales forecasting, pipeline management, and commercial negotiations.
Ability to develop market entry strategies and identify international growth opportunities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM platforms.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Willingness to travel internationally when required.
Experience managing international accounts across multiple geographical regions.
Knowledge of Incoterms, export documentation, customs procedures, and international shipping.
Familiarity with international payment methods, letters of credit, and trade finance.
Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Understanding of international pricing strategies and market competitiveness.
Knowledge of international trade regulations and compliance requirements.
Additional language proficiency would be an advantage.
MBA or professional certification in International Business or Sales Management would be preferred.
International revenue growth and sales target achievement.
New market penetration and geographical expansion.
Sales pipeline growth and conversion rates.
Gross profit margins and overall sales profitability.

Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 125 premium private schools spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13.

In 28 countries, Inspired schools are individually developed and anchored in the vibrant cultures of their respective locations. They collectively form an international family of schools that nurtures each student's academic and personal development in a progressive, dynamic, and innovative learning environment.

By joining our award-winning team of over 14,000 employees, you can work in state-of-the-art facilities alongside industry-renowned educators and leaders in some of the world's most desirable locations. We invest heavily in our team members who enjoy industry-leading professional development, exceptional career opportunities, and mobility across our group.

The British School of Bahrain is renowned for offering the best holistic UK-based education within Bahrain. BSB’s core values of Excellence, Responsibility & Individuality underpin everything that we do and are epitomised by our three pillars of Academics, Sports and the Arts.

BSB delivers high-quality British education to around 2,600 students aged 3 to 18 years and employs 306 full-time staff representing 31 different countries who are carefully handpicked. BSB is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. Successful candidates will be subject to an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check/ICPC or equivalent and satisfactory pre-employment references.

BSB is a vibrant and enjoyable place to work, and is renowned for its pedagogy, staff development and academic success. The value we place on individuality is evident in our inclusive and innovative teaching approach. Our curriculum is based on the National Curriculum for England and Wales, with some adaptations to the local context and offers IGCSE, BTEC and A-Level examinations. Our aim is to provide our graduating students with a passport to the best universities, colleges and careers around the world.
We are seeking to appoint a Teacher of Chemistry to start in August, 2027.
q: A degree and PGCE or B.Ed or the equivalent. The degree must be in the subject taught or a closely related subject
Experience teaching the British curriculum up to GCSE and A-level students is highly desirable
Confidence with the use of ICT in teaching
Enhanced disclosure from the DBS or equivalent, and who are committed to the welfare of all children
High expectations and aspirations for all students
A commitment to the overall development of young people
An open-minded approach to their work, and willing to learn and develop
A demonstrable love for what they do and a proven track record
To be considered for this position, you will need to meet our qualifications and experience requirements.

In return, we offer an attractive expatriate remuneration package, including a competitive tax-free salary, housing allowance, health insurance, annual flight and relocation assistance, and 2 free places for children.

Inspired Education Group is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practices and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
Visit our careers site for more information; https://jobs.inspirededu.com
